_comment: How playwright.yml packs ci_matrix.json shards onto runners. Shard ownership, smoke selection and validation still work per shard; this file only decides which shards share one job, its worker count and its runner label (default eks-openobserve-standard-16). Merged shards share one OpenObserve process, so build-ci-matrix.js refuses to merge shards that pin workers or need different server-start settings. workers must leave 2 cores of the runner free. Sizing comes from CPU per busy worker measured on run 40824034083: dense shards (Logs-Features, Dashboards-Variables, Logs-Core) are mixed with wait-bound ones (Traces, Functions, Reports) so each 16-core runner lands near 10 cores (~65%). Run 40830786208 showed that an average above ~70% keeps the runner at its CPU limit and stretches test time (Combined-1 at 78% avg ran +29%), so Dashboards-Variables moved to Combined-5 (whose long tail left cores idle) in exchange for wait-bound Traces-Search, and Combined-6 (twice its predicted CPU) dropped to 12 workers. Own-server shards are light (peaks under 2 cores, or under 6 for SLO/Synthetics) and move to smaller runners.
